items.title: HIN verification
items.guidance: Confirm the Hull Identification Number on the transom matches the documents; check for tampering, grinding, or overstamping.

items.title: Registration / title match
items.guidance: Verify state registration and title numbers and the owner name match the vessel and paperwork.

items.title: Builder's plate
items.guidance: Locate the manufacturer's plate; record builder, model, and build date.

items.title: Capacity / certification plate
items.guidance: Check the capacity plate (persons / weight) and any CE or NMMA certification.

items.title: USCG / state documentation
items.guidance: Review documentation or state papers; confirm hailing port and numbers are correctly displayed.

items.title: Prior survey & service records
items.guidance: Collect and review prior surveys, maintenance logs, and major repair invoices.

items.title: Ownership & lien check notes
items.guidance: Note the chain of ownership and any liens, encumbrances, or outstanding finance disclosed.

items.title: Insurance & compliance documents
items.guidance: Record current insurance, radio licence, and any flag-state compliance certificates.

items.title: Gelcoat condition & blisters
items.guidance: Inspect topsides and bottom for gelcoat crazing, blisters, and signs of osmosis below the waterline.

items.title: Keel-to-hull joint
items.guidance: Check the keel joint for cracks, weeping, fairing failure, and evidence of grounding.

items.title: Hull-to-deck joint
items.guidance: Inspect the hull/deck joint for separation, leaks, and fastener integrity.

items.title: Stress / structural cracks
items.guidance: Look for stress cracks at high-load areas, chainplates, and bulkhead tabbing.

items.title: Through-hulls & seacocks
items.guidance: Operate every seacock; check bonding, backing blocks, hose double-clamping, and corrosion.

items.title: Transom & swim platform
items.guidance: Assess the transom for soft spots and cracks, and secure mounting of the platform and ladder.

items.title: Rudder & bearings
items.guidance: Check the rudder for play, cracks, and water intrusion; move it stop to stop and feel the bearings.

items.title: Skeg / keel grounding damage
items.guidance: Inspect the skeg, keel, and running gear for impact, repairs, and fairing.

items.title: Bilge condition
items.guidance: Check the bilge for water, oil, debris, and integrity of limber holes.

items.title: Stringers & bulkheads
items.guidance: Sound stringers and bulkheads for delamination, rot, and secure tabbing.

items.title: Moisture meter readings
items.guidance: Record moisture-meter readings on deck and hull; note elevated or wet areas.

items.title: Anodes / cathodic protection
items.guidance: Check sacrificial anodes for wastage and electrical continuity to bonded metals.

items.title: Non-skid wear
items.guidance: Assess non-skid for wear and traction in walking and working areas.

items.title: Stanchions, pulpit & pushpit
items.guidance: Check stanchions, bow pulpit, and stern rail for secure bases and bends.

items.title: Lifelines & gates
items.guidance: Inspect lifelines for fraying, corrosion, and proper tension; test gate latches.

items.title: Cleats, chocks & fairleads
items.guidance: Verify cleats and chocks are through-bolted with adequate backing.

items.title: Hatches & ports
items.guidance: Open and close all hatches and ports; check seals, dogs, and crazing of acrylic.

items.title: Deck hardware backing plates
items.guidance: Spot-check backing plates and bedding for leaks at high-load fittings.

items.title: Anchor windlass
items.guidance: Operate the windlass; check the gypsy, clutch, breaker, and chain stopper.

items.title: Bow roller & ground tackle
items.guidance: Inspect the bow roller, anchor, rode, and shackle mousing.

items.title: Toe rail & rub rail
items.guidance: Check toe rail and rub rail for damage and secure fastening.

items.title: Engine mounts — condition & security
items.guidance: Inspect mounts for cracked rubber, rust streaks, loose nuts, and sag.

items.title: Belts & pulleys
items.guidance: Check belt tension, glazing, and cracking, and pulley alignment.

items.title: Hoses & clamps
items.guidance: Inspect coolant, fuel, and exhaust hoses for softness and bulging, and confirm double clamping.

items.title: Fuel system & filters
items.guidance: Check primary and secondary fuel filters, service dates, and for leaks or weeping.

items.title: Cooling system / heat exchanger
items.guidance: Inspect coolant level, heat exchanger, and signs of overheating or salt tracks.

items.title: Raw water pump & impeller
items.guidance: Note impeller age; check the pump for weeping and the strainer for cleanliness.

items.title: Exhaust system / mixing elbow
items.guidance: Inspect the mixing elbow, riser, and exhaust hose for corrosion and leaks.

items.title: Oil level & condition
items.guidance: Check engine oil level and colour, and for emulsification or a fuel smell.

items.title: Coolant condition
items.guidance: Verify coolant strength and the absence of oil contamination.

items.title: Smoke on startup
items.guidance: Observe exhaust smoke colour at cold start and under load.

items.title: Throttle & shift cables
items.guidance: Operate throttle and shift through full range; check for binding and play.

items.title: Hour meter reading
items.guidance: Record engine hours and compare against maintenance records.

items.title: Engine alignment & coupling
items.guidance: Check shaft coupling alignment and for vibration at the cutless bearing.

items.title: Transmission condition
items.guidance: Check gear oil, shifting, and for leaks at the transmission and output seal.

items.title: Tanks condition & mounting
items.guidance: Inspect tanks for corrosion, secure mounting, and labelling.

items.title: Fuel lines & connections
items.guidance: Check for compliant fuel hose, sound routing, and chafe protection.

items.title: Anti-siphon valve
items.guidance: Verify an anti-siphon device at the tank withdrawal fitting.

items.title: Fill & vent
items.guidance: Inspect fill, vent, and grounding; check for cross-threading and leaks.

items.title: Fuel / water separator
items.guidance: Check the separator bowl for water and debris, and the filter date.

items.title: Leaks & odor
items.guidance: Smell the bilge and lockers for fuel odour; trace any leaks.

items.title: Fuel gauge & shutoff
items.guidance: Test fuel gauge accuracy and the accessibility of the fuel shutoff.

items.title: Steering type & general function
items.guidance: Record the steering type (cable, hydraulic, rack) and check overall function.

items.title: Play / binding
items.guidance: Turn the helm lock to lock; note excessive play, binding, or noise.

items.title: Hydraulic fluid & leaks
items.guidance: Check the hydraulic reservoir level and the rams and lines for leaks.

items.title: Cables & sheaves
items.guidance: Inspect steering cables, conduit, and sheaves for wear and corrosion.

items.title: Autopilot
items.guidance: Test autopilot engagement, the drive unit, and the rudder reference.

items.title: Emergency tiller
items.guidance: Confirm the emergency tiller is aboard and fits the rudder post.

items.title: Trim tabs / power assist
items.guidance: Operate trim tabs and any power-assist; check the actuators.

items.title: Batteries & condition
items.guidance: Record battery type, age, mounting, and terminals, and perform a load / voltage test.

items.title: Battery switches & isolation
items.guidance: Operate battery switches; verify labelling and secure mounting.

items.title: Wiring condition / ABYC
items.guidance: Inspect wiring for chafe, proper support, tinned conductors, and ABYC compliance.

items.title: Main panel & breakers
items.guidance: Check DC and AC panel labelling, breaker function, and signs of heat.

items.title: Shore power & galvanic isolator
items.guidance: Inspect the shore inlet, cord, polarity indicator, and galvanic isolator.

items.title: Charger / inverter
items.guidance: Test charger and inverter operation and mounting; check for alarms.

items.title: Bonding system
items.guidance: Verify bonding continuity to through-hulls and the engine.

items.title: Navigation lights
items.guidance: Test all navigation, anchor, and steaming lights for function and visibility.

items.title: DC outlets & USB
items.guidance: Test accessory outlets and USB charging points.

items.title: AC system & GFCI
items.guidance: Test GFCI outlets and AC grounding where fitted.

items.title: Alternator output
items.guidance: Check alternator charging output and belt; note the regulator type.

items.title: Fresh water system & pump
items.guidance: Test the pressure pump and accumulator, and check for leaks at fittings.

items.title: Hot water heater
items.guidance: Check water heater operation (shore and engine) and the relief valve.

items.title: Head / holding tank
items.guidance: Operate the head; inspect the holding tank and hoses, and for odour permeation.

items.title: Y-valve & overboard discharge
items.guidance: Verify the Y-valve, its securing means, and overboard discharge compliance.

items.title: Bilge pumps (auto & manual)
items.guidance: Test electric and manual bilge pumps and their float switches.

items.title: Float switches & high-water alarm
items.guidance: Confirm float switch operation and any high-water alarm.

items.title: Sea strainers
items.guidance: Inspect raw-water strainers for cleanliness and secure lids.

items.title: Sinks, drains & scuppers
items.guidance: Check sink drains, cockpit scuppers, and seacock backup.

items.title: Shower sump
items.guidance: Test the shower sump pump and screen.

items.title: Standing rigging & swages
items.guidance: Inspect wire, swages, and terminals for cracks, meathooks, and corrosion.

items.title: Chainplates
items.guidance: Check chainplates and deck seals for cracks, movement, and crevice corrosion.

items.title: Mast & spreaders
items.guidance: Inspect the mast, spreaders, and tangs; note corrosion and fastener condition.

items.title: Furling gear
items.guidance: Operate the headsail and mainsail furler; check the drum, foil, and bearings.

items.title: Running rigging
items.guidance: Assess halyards, sheets, and control lines for wear and UV damage.

items.title: Winches
items.guidance: Service-check winches for smooth operation and pawl function.

items.title: Boom & vang
items.guidance: Inspect the boom, gooseneck, and vang for cracks and play.

items.title: Sail condition
items.guidance: Review the sail inventory for UV damage, stitching, and batten cars.

items.title: Mast step & partners
items.guidance: Check the mast step (keel or deck) and partners for corrosion and compression.

items.title: Life jackets (PFDs)
items.guidance: Count and inspect PFDs for serviceability, size range, and stowage.

items.title: Fire extinguishers & dates
items.guidance: Check extinguisher type, charge, mounting, and inspection dates.

items.title: Flares & visual distress
items.guidance: Verify flare expiry dates and adequate day and night signals.

items.title: EPIRB / PLB
items.guidance: Check EPIRB registration, battery date, and hydrostatic release.

items.title: Horn / bell / sound signals
items.guidance: Test the horn and confirm a bell where required.

items.title: First aid kit
items.guidance: Inspect first aid kit contents and condition.

items.title: Bilge / high-water alarm
items.guidance: Confirm the audible bilge alarm functions.

items.title: CO detector
items.guidance: Test carbon monoxide detector(s) and battery.

items.title: Propane / LPG locker & solenoid
items.guidance: Check LPG locker drainage, solenoid, sniffer, and regulator.

items.title: Life raft & ditch bag
items.guidance: Note the life raft service date and ditch bag contents if fitted.

items.title: Throwable & overboard recovery
items.guidance: Confirm a throwable PFD and man-overboard recovery gear.

items.title: Stove / propane appliance
items.guidance: Test stove ignition, gimbal, and shutoff; check for gas leaks.

items.title: Refrigeration
items.guidance: Check refrigeration cooling, compressor, and insulation.

items.title: Upholstery & mildew
items.guidance: Inspect cushions and upholstery for wear, mildew, and odour.

items.title: Headliner & trim
items.guidance: Check the headliner for staining, sagging, and water tracks.

items.title: Cabin sole
items.guidance: Sound the sole for soft spots, delamination, and secure footing.

items.title: Ventilation & dorades
items.guidance: Assess ventilation, dorade boxes, and opening ports for airflow.

items.title: Freshwater leaks / staining
items.guidance: Trace any water staining to deck or plumbing leaks.

items.title: Doors, drawers & latches
items.guidance: Operate interior joinery, latches, and sea rails.

items.title: Chartplotter / GPS
items.guidance: Power up the chartplotter; confirm GPS fix, charts, and mounting.

items.title: VHF & DSC
items.guidance: Test VHF transmit and receive, DSC, and MMSI programming.

items.title: Radar
items.guidance: Power the radar; check transmit, scanner mounting, and image.

items.title: Depth / speed / wind
items.guidance: Verify depth, speed, and wind instruments read plausibly.

items.title: AIS
items.guidance: Confirm AIS transmit and receive and target display.

items.title: Antennas & cabling
items.guidance: Inspect antennas, connectors, and coax for corrosion.

items.title: Compass & heading sensor
items.guidance: Check the compass deviation card and the heading sensor.

items.title: Frame & welds
items.guidance: Inspect the trailer frame and welds for rust-through and cracks.

items.title: Tires & spare
items.guidance: Check tire age, tread, and pressure, and the presence of a spare.

items.title: Bearings & hubs
items.guidance: Spin hubs for bearing roughness; check for grease and heat.

items.title: Lights & wiring
items.guidance: Test running, brake, and turn signals; inspect the wiring.

items.title: Brakes
items.guidance: Check surge or electric brakes, the actuator, and the breakaway.

items.title: Winch & strap
items.guidance: Inspect the winch, strap or cable, and safety chain.

items.title: Coupler & safety chains
items.guidance: Verify coupler fit and lock, and crossed safety chains.

items.title: Bunks / rollers & supports
items.guidance: Check bunks, rollers, and keel support condition.
